24:21.text: O you who believe! Follow not the footsteps of Shaitân
. And whosoever follows the footsteps of Shaitân
[disbelief and polytheism (i.e. to do evil and wicked deeds; and to speak or to do what is forbidden in Islâm)]
. And had it not been for the Grace of Allâh and His Mercy on you, not one of you would ever have been pure from sins. But Allâh purifies
whom He wills, and Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

24:22.text: And let not those among you who are blessed with graces and wealth swear not to give
, and those who left their homes for Allâh’s Cause. Let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allâh should forgive you? And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

24:23.text: Verily, those who accuse chaste women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity and are good believers - are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter, and for them will be a great torment -

24:24.text: On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their legs
will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

24:25.text: On that Day Allâh will pay them the recompense of their deeds in full, and they will know that Allâh, He is the Manifest Truth.

24:26.text: Bad statements are for bad people
and bad people for bad statements
. Good statements are for good people
and good people for good statements
bad statement which they say; for them is Forgiveness, and Rizqun Karîm

24:27.text: O you who believe! Enter not houses other than your own, until you have asked permission and greeted those in them; that is better for you, in order that you may remember.
